module_summary: Lemmings walker controller: a 4-state Moore FSM switches direction on bumps and falls when ground is lost, decoding walk/fall outputs from state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Holds walk-left, walk-right, fall-left, fall-right mode; drives all outputs.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from WL state.

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from WR state.

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: Moore output asserted in either falling state.

groups.name: walker_fsm
groups.description: Direction/fall FSM steered by bumps and ground, decoding mode outputs.
